messages.text: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

The passages do not explicitly rank “most important” S-parameter capabilities for Aerospace / Defense, but they support prioritizing VNA/S-parameter capabilities around satellite payload and component testing, especially converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements [105].
### Key supported capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Wide frequency coverage to mmWave | R&S ZNA covers 10 MHz to 67 GHz, and R&S ZNA67EXT extends VNA measurements to 10 MHz to 110 GHz [38][29]. | [38][29] |
| High dynamic range and sensitivity | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, up to 170 dB maximum attainable range, and sensitivity >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth without options [92]. | [92] |
| 2-port / 4-port coherent architecture for antennas and arrays | R&S ZNA 4-port instruments provide up to 4 independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources, and support true parallel and coherent data acquisition for antenna array tests and antenna test systems [37]. | [37] |
| Group delay and phase measurement | Satellite communications use group delay measurements to characterize phase distortion in the transmission path, and relative group delay is critical for frequency converter or transponder channel band-edge distortion [14]. | [14] |
| Frequency-converter and mixer measurements | R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level satellite testing, especially converters and mixers, and its options include scalar mixer, vector mixer, and group delay measurements on frequency converters without LO access [105][94]. | [105][94] |
| Pulsed-signal measurement | R&S ZNA supports measurements on pulsed signals via R&S ZNA-K7, which requires R&S ZNA-K17 together with a pulse modulator, and hardware can include internal pulse modulators with 40 ns minimum pulse width [94][37]. | [94][37] |
| Noise figure measurement | R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level satellite testing including noise figure, and R&S ZNA-K30 is the noise figure measurement option [105][94]. | [105][94] |
| Time-domain / TDR capability | R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K2 Time domain analysis (TDR) and R&S ZNA-K20 extended time domain analysis including eye diagram [94]. | [94] |
| De-embedding for fixtures and interconnects | R&S ZNA software / measurement options include EaZy deembedding, in-situ deembedding, smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [20]. | [20] |
| Measurement accuracy / uncertainty support | R&S ZNA options include uncertainty analysis R&S ZNA-K50 and R&S ZNA-K50P, and the specifications define uncertainties using coverage factor 2 according to GUM [94][63]. | [94][63] |
### Product / option mapping
| Product line | S-parameter capability to emphasize | Confirmed option / specification | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA | Core high-performance VNA for component-level satellite testing | 10 MHz to 67 GHz family coverage; dynamic range >129 dB without options; up to 170 dB maximum attainable range [38][92]. | [38][92] |
| R&S ZNA67EXT | 110 GHz mmWave S-parameter coverage | 1.0 mm VNA system, 10 MHz to 110 GHz, 2 or 4 test ports depending on model [29]. | [29] |
| R&S ZNA 4-port models | Coherent multiport / antenna-array measurements | Up to 4 phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources and true parallel coherent data acquisition for antenna array tests [37]. | [37] |
| R&S ZNA options | Frequency converters, mixers, group delay and phase | R&S ZNA-K4 scalar mixer, R&S ZNA-K5 vector mixer, R&S ZNA-K9 group delay on frequency converters without LO access, R&S ZNA-K6 phase coherent source control [94]. | [94] |
| R&S ZNA options | Pulsed S-parameter work | R&S ZNA-K7 measurements on pulsed signals; R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz; pulse modulator minimum pulse width 40 ns [94][37]. | [94][37] |
| R&S ZNA options | Time-domain and interconnect analysis | R&S ZNA-K2 Time domain analysis (TDR), R&S ZNA-K20 extended time domain analysis including eye diagram, R&S ZNA-K210/K220/K230 deembedding, R&S ZNA-K231 Delta-L PCB characterization [94][20]. | [94][20] |
| R&S ZNA options | Noise figure and uncertainty | R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement and R&S ZNA-K50 / K50P uncertainty analysis [94]. | [94] |

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 為什麼量測 group delay
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- [[Group delay]] measurements 用於表徵 satellite communications transmission path 的 phase distortions。
- Bandpass filter 會在 band edges 增加更多 group delay。
- 在 satellite communications systems 中，frequency converter 或 transponder channels 的 relative group delay 對判定 each channel band edges 的 distortion amount 很關鍵。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的適用性與優點
- 適合 unstable LOs 的 frequency converting DUTs，因 DUT internal LO 的 frequency 與 phase deviations 可落在 IF bandwidth 範圍內，最高到 several MHz。
- New internal combiner 可簡化 measurement setup，兩個 signals 不再需要 external connection。
- Two-port [[R&S ZNA]] 搭配 optional second source，可量測 embedded LO converter group delay 與 intermodulation。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 的 two independent LOs for internal receivers 可讓 mixers 的 RF/IF 同時量測。
- Measurement speeds 為 single LO 的兩倍，並降低 conversion loss 與 group delay measurements 的 trace noise。
- 除 group delay 外，也可透過 integrating group delay 計算 relative phase 與 deviation from linear phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。

| Group delay and phase measurement | Satellite communications use group delay measurements to characterize phase distortion in the transmission path, and relative group delay is critical for frequency converter or transponder channel band-edge distortion [14]. | [14] |

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
